admin.title: Admin
admin.login_intro: Authentication is required before opening the PhotoBooth administration area.
admin.password_not_set: ADMIN_PASSWORD is not set in config.ini. Admin access is disabled.
admin.password_not_set_actions: ADMIN_PASSWORD is not set in config.ini. Admin actions are disabled.
admin.remote_intro: Everything guests sent from the remote capture page. Rejecting a photo takes it out of the booth queue; deleting also removes the file.
admin.remote_disabled_warning: Remote capture is disabled. Turn on REMOTE_CAPTURE in the admin configuration and restart the application.
admin.no_photo_yet: No phone has sent a photo yet.

admin.config_saved_restart: config.ini saved. Restart app to apply all changes.
admin.config_saved_password_disabled: config.ini saved. Admin password disabled. Sign in is now disabled.
admin.restart_requested: Application restart requested. Page may become unavailable for a few seconds.
admin.control_panel_intro: Everything needed to manage templates, application settings and maintenance is grouped here with the most common actions first.
admin.edit_layouts_hint: Create, duplicate and save print templates from the visual editor.
admin.restart_or_clean_hint: Restart the booth after changes, or remove all saved sessions from the danger zone below.
admin.read_app_logs_hint: Open the newest log files from the logs folder directly in the browser.
admin.moderate_phone_photos_hint: See what guests sent from their own phone, and take anything unwanted out of the booth queue.
admin.edit_config_ini_hint: Use this section when a printer, countdown, port or hardware setting must be changed. Choice-based fields use dropdowns, booleans use checkboxes, and CALIBRATION remains a raw string.
admin.apply_changes_hint: Apply your changes here, then restart PhotoBooth so the new configuration is loaded.
admin.config_tip: Tip: save first, then use the restart action above to apply the updated configuration to the running application.
admin.delete_saved_photos_hint: This permanently removes all saved images, session folders and statistics linked to this session.
admin.delete_saved_photos_warning: Only use this action when you intentionally want to clear the booth history.
